title: Origin story: Lanternwise
description: Lanternwise was a toll-keeper's widow who hung lanterns at the crossroads so travelers would not lose their way, and kept hanging them for fifty years. The crossroads adopted her: now her lanterns light paths that don't exist on any map, and the lost find her light before they know they're lost.
